description: This is a PHP class file defining the MyInfoDetailedModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class models detailed employee information for API responses, including employee name, ID, job title, subunit, and termination info. It uses traits and interfaces for serialization and normalizing data, and constructs itself based on an Employee entity.

classes.name: MyInfoDetailedModel
classes.description: A PHP model class representing detailed employee information for API responses, constructed from an Employee entity, with serialization and normalization capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity, setting entity data, filters, and attribute mappings for output.
